description: Script for parsing native package index files (apk and opkg) into JSON format for downstream tools, with command-line argument parsing and package processing functions.

methods.name: removesuffix
methods.description: Removes a specified suffix from a string, compatible with Python versions earlier than 3.9.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for architecture, source format, manifest output, and input source.

methods.name: parse_apk
methods.description: Parses APK package JSON data to extract package names and versions, handling ABI suffix removal.

methods.name: parse_opkg
methods.description: Parses opkg package list text to extract package names and versions, handling ABI suffix removal.
